runtime_actions.command: Run the included PowerShell launcher separately for field and source at (6,40); run writer only after those two are stable. Use one target and one downstream breakpoint per invocation. Fill RETURN_RUNTIME_TRACE_TEMPLATE.json from fresh Windows debugger output.
runtime_actions.stop_condition: Satisfactory: an exact RDI==target_output stop returns typed RCX field words or RDX source words for (6,40). Partial: entry address is derived but the single selected site misses with the failed comparison retained. Failure: multiple downstream sites in one run, rbp=y or broad r9=x gating, PNG-only evidence, or package-local recomputation.
